visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Medium: Live-action video featuring two cats positioned on a couch. A ginger cat sits on the left holding a blue and red handheld game console with its paws, appearing to play it. A grey cat sits on the right holding a silver beverage can. The setting is a living room with a brown couch and two wooden doors in the background. A white camera recording interface overlay is visible, and white text at the bottom reads "When the cat's owner comes home". (2) A man wearing a grey t-shirt and jeans enters the frame through the door on the left, looking toward the cats. (3) The cats react frantically; the ginger cat tosses the console aside and the grey cat drops the can. Both cats immediately lie flat on the couch and close their eyes, pretending to sleep. The man stands by the couch with a confused facial expression, hands at his sides. (4) The scene cuts to the same room at night with dim lighting. The cats are back in their sitting positions, one playing the console and the other drinking from the can. (5) A woman with long dark hair enters through the door carrying a plastic bag containing green leafy vegetables. (6) The cats repeat the rapid movement, discarding their items and instantly sprawling out in a sleeping pose. The woman stops and looks at the cats with a startled and puzzled expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, 8-bit electronic background music plays with a bright synth lead and a strong, rhythmic beat. No vocals are present. (2) A sharp mechanical thud and metallic creak signal a door opening. The music stops instantly, replaced by a half-second of silence. (3) A series of rapid, messy scrambling sounds occur, followed by a heavy plastic thud and a hollow metal clank, suggesting objects hitting a floor and a table. (4) A short, airy sliding sound like fabric moving occurs, followed by silence. (5) The 8-bit music resumes at the original volume and tempo. (6) A second sharp mechanical creak and door-latch sound trigger another immediate cut in the music. (7) Frantic rustling sounds of plastic and cloth are heard, followed by a metallic clatter and a final dull thud of something soft hitting a cushion. The track ends in absolute silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a comedic contrast between cats acting like sophisticated humans (playing games, drinking) and their immediate instinct to pretend to be 'normal' sleeping pets the moment their owners return. It parodies the behavior of teenagers hiding forbidden activities from parents.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While a Nintendo Switch is clearly visible, the video's amateur meme style and focus on humor suggest organic usage rather than a formal partnership.
